answer_1.quote: Disentangling them from content can assist tasks that rely on core content preservation such as controlled generation and abstractive summarization.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates reconstructions of input sentences and performs controlled generation by flipping negation or uncertainty status in the latent space.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate faithfulness in terms of the ability of the model to preserve the negation, uncertainty, and content of the input... we approximate a measure of content preservation... by computing the BLEU score between the input and the reconstruction (self-BLEU)... We evaluate fluency of the reconstruction by computing the perplexities (PPL) under GPT-2, a strong, general-domain language model.
